quote_zh: 将26.46g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.6％、0.1mol)，200ml二氯乙烷，0.174g间氯过氧苯甲酸(99％、0.001mol)，16.88g氢溴酸(48％、0.1mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在50～55℃滴加11.33g双氧水(30％、0.1mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，异丙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得31.33g白色粉末，纯度98.0％，收率90％。
arithmetic_check: Charges, all read at the printed assay. Substrate 26.46 g at 99.6 per cent = 26.35 g; over 0.1 mol this implies MW 263.5 against C10H11ClO4S = 262.70, high by 0.3 per cent, correct. m-Chloroperoxybenzoic acid 0.174 g at 99 per cent = 0.1723 g; over 0.001 mol implies 172.3 against C7H5ClO3 = 172.56, correct. Hydrobromic acid 16.88 g at 48 per cent = 8.10 g; over 0.1 mol implies 81.0 against HBr = 80.91, correct. Hydrogen peroxide 11.33 g at 30 per cent = 3.40 g; over 0.1 mol implies 34.0 against H2O2 = 34.01, correct. No molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: limiting input 0.100 mol; product C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60; theoretical 0.100 x 341.60 = 34.16 g; printed mass 31.33 g = 91.7 per cent of theory as weighed, against a printed yield of 90 per cent. Corrected to the printed 98.0 per cent assay the product is 30.70 g = 89.9 per cent of theory, which matches the printed 90 per cent to within 0.1 point. CLOSES on the assay-corrected reading, which is the reading the patent evidently uses, since the same correction closes steps 2 and 3 to within 0.05 point as well. No flag raised. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.

quote_zh: 将34.5g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.0％、0.1mol)，13.94g碳酸钾(99％、0.1mol)，0.226g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.001mol)，200ml丙酮，10.1g  2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.1mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在0～5℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里4.04g氢氧化钠(99％、0.1mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得31.58g白色粉末，纯度99.3％，收率90.5％。
arithmetic_check: One-pot step, two transformations, one isolated product, so closure is tested on the overall step. Charges: substrate 34.5 g at 99.0 per cent = 34.16 g; over 0.1 mol implies MW 341.6 against C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, exact. Potassium carbonate 13.94 g at 99 per cent = 13.80 g; implies 138.0 against 138.21, correct. 2,2,2-Trifluoroethanol 10.1 g at 99 per cent = 10.00 g; implies 100.0 against C2H3F3O = 100.04, correct. Sodium hydroxide 4.04 g at 99 per cent = 4.00 g; implies 40.0 against 40.00, exact. TRIETHYLENEDIAMINE DOES NOT CLOSE, and it is the only charge in the section that does not. Printed as 0.226g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.001mol). Triethylenediamine, 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, C6H12N2, MW 112.17. 0.226 g at 99 per cent = 0.2237 g; over the printed 0.001 mol this implies MW 223.7, which is 1.99 times the true 112.17. Read from the mass instead, 0.2237 g / 112.17 = 0.001995 mol, i.e. 0.002 mol against a printed 0.001 mol. The mass for a true 0.001 mol charge at 99 per cent would be 0.113 g. The defect is a clean factor of two and nothing else in the step shares it. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Both figures recorded exactly as printed and neither corrected. Product closure: limiting input 0.100 mol; product C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.70; theoretical 34.67 g; printed 31.58 g = 91.1 per cent of theory as weighed; at the printed 99.3 per cent assay 31.36 g = 90.45 per cent against a printed 90.5 per cent. CLOSES, so mass_balance_implausible is NOT raised. Continuity: step 1 isolated 31.33 g of the bromide but this step charges 34.5 g, more than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. The purities also disagree across the handover, isolated at 98.0 per cent and charged at 99.0 per cent, which no flag in the closed list covers and which is recorded in notes instead.

Decisively for this record it is drawn as the free carboxylic ACID and not as an ester, which corroborates the prose that the ester formed by the etherification is hydrolysed in the same pot and supports keeping the two transformations as one record. quote_zh: 将34 .75g  2-氯-3-(2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99 .7％、0.1mol)，0.074g  DMF(99％、0.001mol)，12g氯化亚砜(99％、0.1mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将11 .3g  1 ,3-环己二酮(99％、0.1mol)、100ml二氯乙烷加入反应瓶，在0～5℃滴加20.4g三乙胺(99％、0.2mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入0.09g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.001mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加甲醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得37.94g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.7％，收率85％。
arithmetic_check: One-pot step, three transformations, one isolated product. Charges: substrate 34.75 g at 99.7 per cent = 34.65 g; over 0.1 mol implies MW 346.5 against C11H10ClF3O5S = 346.70, correct. DMF 0.074 g at 99 per cent = 0.0733 g; over 0.001 mol implies 73.3 against 73.09, correct. Thionyl chloride 12 g at 99 per cent = 11.88 g; over 0.1 mol implies 118.8 against SOCl2 = 118.97, correct. 1,3-Cyclohexanedione 11.3 g at 99 per cent = 11.19 g; over 0.1 mol implies 111.9 against C6H8O2 = 112.13, correct. Triethylamine 20.4 g at 99 per cent = 20.20 g; over 0.2 mol implies 101.0 against C6H15N = 101.19, correct, and the 2.0 equivalents against the 0.1 mol substrate are consistent with taking up the acid liberated in the acylation. Acetone cyanohydrin 0.09 g at 95 per cent = 0.0855 g; over 0.001 mol implies 85.5 against C4H7NO = 85.11, correct. No molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: limiting input 0.100 mol; product C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82; theoretical 44.08 g; printed 37.94 g = 86.1 per cent of theory as weighed; at the printed 98.7 per cent assay 37.45 g = 84.95 per cent against a printed 85 per cent. CLOSES, so mass_balance_implausible is NOT raised. Continuity: step 2 isolated 31.58 g of the acid but this step charges 34.75 g, more than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Purities again disagree across the handover, isolated at 99.3 per cent and charged at 99.7 per cent. SECTION SUMMARY OF THE ARITHMETIC: every mass and mole pair in Example 3 is internally correct except the triethylenediamine charge in step 2, which is out by a factor of two; and all three product mass/yield pairs close to within 0.15 point once the printed assay is applied, which is a consistent and evidently deliberate convention in this document. The only structural defect across the section is that each step charges more of the preceding step's product than that step isolated.
